title: Avimi of Hagronya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Rava, observing that Rav Mordechai always said to Rav Ashi, "Thus said Avimi of Hagronia in the name of Rava" (Ketubot 109b; Bava Metzia 77b, 96a; Bava Batra 174b; Makkot 13b). And once we find that he spoke in the name of Rav Huna (Yevamot 64b).
